segments.title: Siri AI now has a DAILY limit
segments.say: Siri AI now has a daily limit on iPhone. Here's what still works.

segments.title: Simple asks keep working
segments.say: Simple requests, like timers, keep working. Advanced Siri AI pauses until it resets.

segments.title: Resets around midnight
segments.say: It resets around midnight, and unused uses don't roll over.

segments.title: Bigger iCloud+ = more uses
segments.say: Bigger iCloud plus plans get more, up to twenty times the standard limit, from iOS twenty-seven point three.

segments.title: Source: Apple Support
segments.sub: Not tested by us · **not in EU, UK, Brazil, S. Korea**
segments.say: That's from Apple's support page. Not tested by us.
Follow for Phone Trick number 18 tomorrow.
